revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found (all quotes passed the deterministic check and hold up on manual review). However, three targeted fixes are needed before approval: (1) The cherry_pick_moments[0] citation of protocols.how_did_you_get_my_number is a schema misuse \u2014 the customer never asked the trigger question; he volunteered mild surprise then explicitly waived it ('that's okay, you can tell me about it'). Reframe this moment as a soft, resolved legitimacy beat rather than a protocol violation, or cite intros.standard coaching_notes instead. (2) script_coverage mislabels the 01:30 beat as 'tax_credit_qualifier' when it is actually the credit_qualifier (650 vs schema's 670 threshold) \u2014 relabel correctly AND flag this under schema_drift_detection, since the rep stated 650 exactly matching the known drift pattern from SESSION18_fcbf33c1 that Stage 3 missed entirely. (3) Add the customer's disability disclosure at 03:30 ('I'm handicapped, so it takes me a few minutes to get in the house') as a vulnerability_disclosure moment per coaching_philosophy.empathy_on_vulnerability_disclosure \u2014 the rep's response ('Yeah. No problem at all.') is acknowledge-and-move-on, not empathetic engagement, and this is a real schema-defined gap currently absorbed into the generic 'conditional_booking' tag and lost. Additionally, reconsider the trajectory_verdict.shape label 'stagnant,' which contradicts Stage 3's own state_changes showing three positive deltas before a genuine external interruption \u2014 an ascending/interrupted shape is better supported. The outcome_dispute reclassification to 'callback' is correct and should be kept as-is.
